content:
I've been working on a Lean 4 formalization of the Nyman-Beurling-Báez-Duarte criterion for the Riemann Hypothesis. The converse direction (d²→0 ⟹ RH) is proved with zero custom axioms. The forward direction reduces to one axiom equivalent to RH.

lake build compiles against Mathlib v4.29.0 (~504 files, ~158K lines, 0 sorry on crown path).

Zenodo: https://zenodo.org/records/20803093

Happy to discuss the architecture and open problems.
This topic was moved here from #maths > Nyman-Beurling equivalence for RH in Lean 4 by Kevin Buzzard.

@Jason Gochanour, I recommend having a github repository, containing a CI script running leanprover/comparator against a Challenge.lean file showing your claimed result (and which has no imports outside of Mathlib; of course the Solution.lean file may).
See e.g. my kim-em/erdos-unit-distance and kim-em/erdos-unit-distance-comparator repositories if you need a model.
Thank you Kim! I'll look into this after catching up on some more sleep :) The GitHub repo is live, but doesn't have a CI script running leanprover/comparator

@Kim Morrison I worked with Claude to get the main claim set up in a Challenge.lean/Solution.lean and Claude wrote a script to build/verify through GitHub actions.

(I'll work towards the proper leanprover/comparator tomorrow) Thank you again for letting me know about the proper setup for that. Going to read through your repos and call it a night.

Also did a little cleanup. Code is available at jrgochan/prime.

Planning on making the various visualizations/tools more developer friendly and POSIX compliant. They may require some more fiddling.

Worked with Claude to fix a few bugs in the visualizers, and also found a bug in the Gravity logic.

Progress update — ArithmeticGravity.lean

Graduated 3 of 4 axioms to theorems:

  • diagonal_positive: delegates to existing vasyuninGramEntry_diag_pos in Structural.lean
  • diagonal_monotone_decay: corrected — the original statement was false for k=1 (G(1,1) ≈ 0.261 < G(2,2) ≈ 0.380). Now proved for k ≥ 2.
  • hierarchy_ratio: proved — reduces to k ≥ 1 after algebra

One axiom remaining: gravitational_universality (G(j,k) ≠ 0 for all j,k ≥ 1). This is the genuinely hard one — requires showing the off-diagonal Vasyunin Gram entries can't vanish.

Builds clean. Merge commit: https://github.com/jrgochan/prime/commit/54d74308

Also added a reference to Bianconi's "Gravity from entropy" (arXiv:2408.14391) as independently convergent work — striking structural parallels in deriving gravity as emergent from entropic structure.
